statement: The full local point section at [2:y:1] on U7/Q7, with y^7=-129, is intrinsically ramified in the geometric pro-three quotient and is not cuspidal even in geometric abelianization.
depends_on: A.48 intrinsic ramification definition; Hensel lemma; exact local cubic Kummer classes; functoriality to the tripod
answers: A.9 independent bad-prime local interpretation; A.11 scope of local ramification arguments; Lead4 local hypothesis audit
notes: The polynomial ((4+7z)^7+129)/49 reduces to z+1 modulo7, giving y congruent46 modulo49. The tripod unit pair (-128,129) has cubic Kummer coordinates(2,1), outside all three cusp lines in F3². Inertia at7 still acts nontrivially on the boundary permutation module. This is an actual full LOCAL section. No global full-section lift is asserted, and the literal global A9 conclusion under the named local input is not refuted.
